SELECT product_name, price FROM products WHERE price > 150 AND price < 300
SELECT first_name, last_name, hire_date FROM employees WHERE YEAR(hire_date) = 2023;
SELECT product_name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT inventory_id, product_id, warehouse_id, quantity FROM inventory WHERE quantity < 50;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM categories;
SELECT product_name, price FROM products ORDER BY price ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT first_name, last_name FROM employees WHERE manager_id IS NULL;
SELECT first_name, last_name, city FROM customers WHERE city = 'Hamburg';
SELECT department_name, location FROM departments WHERE location = 'Berlin'
SELECT p.product_name, c.category_name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE c.category_name = 'Laptops';
SELECT DISTINCT c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, d.department_name FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id WHERE d.department_name = 'Sales'

SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, o.status 
FROM orders o 
JOIN employees e ON o.employee_id = e.employee_id 
WHERE e.first_name = 'Julia' AND e.last_name = 'Becker'

SELECT i.product_id, i.quantity
FROM inventories i
JOIN warehouses w ON i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
WHERE w.warehouse_name = 'Munich Regional Warehouse';
SELECT product_name, quantity FROM products WHERE quantity > 2;

SELECT p.product_name, s.quantity 
FROM products p 
JOIN stock s ON p.product_id = s.product_id 
WHERE s.quantity < 30
SELECT o.order_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, o.order_date FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.city = 'Munich'
SELECT li.order_id, li.product_id, li.quantity, li.unit_price FROM line_items li JOIN orders o ON li.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'cancelled'

SELECT p.product_name, c.category_name 
FROM products p 
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id 
WHERE c.category_name = 'Audio';

SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, d.department_name
FROM employees e
JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id
WHERE d.department_name = 'Fulfillment';
SELECT o.order_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, o.status FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND c.country = 'Germany';

SELECT product_id, quantity 
FROM inventory 
WHERE fulfillment_center = 'Hamburg' 
  AND quantity > 100;
SELECT DISTINCT p.product_name, o.unit_price FROM products p JOIN order_details o ON p.product_id = o.product_id WHERE o.unit_price > 500
SELECT p.product_name, c.category_name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.category_name = 'Fitness Equipment'
SELECT d.department_name, COUNT(e.employee_id) AS employee_count FROM departments d LEFT JOIN employees e ON d.department_id = e.department_id GROUP BY d.department_id, d.department_name;

SELECT p.product_name, SUM(o.quantity) AS total_sold
FROM products p
JOIN order_items o ON p.product_id = o.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
ORDER BY total_sold DESC
LIMIT 5;
SELECT YEAR(order_date) AS order_year, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY YEAR(order_date);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS laptop_customers
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.category = 'Laptops'

SELECT 
    c.category_name, 
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue
FROM 
    categories c
JOIN 
    products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id
JOIN 
    order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY 
    c.category_name;
SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name

SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS orders_handled
FROM employees e
LEFT JOIN orders o ON e.employee_id = o.employee_id
GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name

SELECT w.warehouse_name, SUM(i.quantity) AS total_stock
FROM warehouses w
JOIN inventory i ON w.warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id
GROUP BY w.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name;

SELECT c.category_name, AVG(p.price) AS avg_price
FROM categories c
JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name
SELECT c.category_name, COUNT(p.product_id) AS product_count FROM categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name

SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name
HAVING COUNT(o.id) > 3;

SELECT c.name AS category_name, SUM(p.price * s.quantity) AS revenue
FROM categories c
JOIN products p ON c.id = p.category_id
JOIN sales s ON p.id = s.product_id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
HAVING SUM(p.price * s.quantity) > 5000;
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status;
SELECT product_name, units_in_stock AS total_units FROM products ORDER BY units_in_stock DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT c.category_name, AVG(oi.unit_price) AS avg_sold_price
FROM categories c
JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id
JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name;

SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, SUM(s.quantity * s.unit_price) AS smartphone_sales
FROM employees e
JOIN sales s ON e.employee_id = s.employee_id
JOIN products p ON s.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.category = 'Smartphone'
GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name
ORDER BY smartphone_sales DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    c.customer_id, 
    c.first_name, 
    c.last_name, 
    SUM(p.amount) AS total_spent
FROM 
    customer c
JOIN 
    payment p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id
GROUP BY 
    c.customer_id, 
    c.first_name, 
    c.last_name
HAVING 
    SUM(p.amount) > (
        SELECT AVG(customer_total)
        FROM (
            SELECT SUM(amount) AS customer_total
            FROM payment
            GROUP BY customer_id
        ) AS avg_spent
    )
SELECT product_name, price, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY price DESC) as price_rank FROM products
SELECT p.product_name FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items o ON p.product_id = o.product_id WHERE o.product_id IS NULL

SELECT p.product_name, p.price, c.category_name
FROM products p
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id
JOIN (
    SELECT category_id, MAX(price) AS max_price
    FROM products
    GROUP BY category_id
) m ON p.category_id = m.category_id AND p.price = m.max_price

SELECT 
    c.first_name, 
    c.last_name, 
    SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(o.total_amount) DESC) AS spend_rank
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name;
SELECT order_id, order_value FROM orders WHERE order_value > (SELECT AVG(order_value) FROM orders)

SELECT DISTINCT c.first_name, c.last_name
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN inventory i ON p.product_id = i.product_id
JOIN warehouses w ON i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
WHERE p.product_name LIKE '%laptop%' AND w.city = 'Berlin';

SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, p.product_name, oi.quantity, oi.unit_price, (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS line_total
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE c.customer_id = (
    SELECT c2.customer_id
    FROM customers c2
    JOIN orders o2 ON c2.customer_id = o2.customer_id
    JOIN order_items oi2 ON o2.order_id = oi2.order_id
    GROUP BY c2.customer_id
    ORDER BY SUM(oi2.quantity * oi2.unit_price) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);
